# Session — 2026-04-04 17:40

## What we were working on
Implementing the four code bug fixes identified in the previous session (CRIT-001, HIGH-001, MED-001, MED-002) for the Polymarket global CLOB trading bot. Also diagnosed why the bot had never placed real live orders despite `LIVE_TRADING=true` — 5,354 closed and 322 open stale paper positions in the JSONL had driven the paper balance to -$220.71, blocking all new position opens. Archived the stale JSONL and fixed a secondary `get_balance()` parsing bug in the US client.
